rows.value: The dock scheduler replaces the fixed weekly plan and gate staff follow its forecast for every shift
The scheduler goes live one week later, after the staff have been trained on the new handheld screens

caption.text: The North terminal at dusk in the sixth pilot week: the orange gate building on the left is where the dock scheduler's forecast is shown to the gate staff, and the gray warehouse on the right holds the handheld screens that the East terminal will receive in January.
